perfect_baseline.proof: If V_b=N, then V_c<=N, so delta_V=V_c-V_b<=0<26

censor_rescue.per_stream: delta_V>=26 AND R_C>=26 AND signed(I_candidate-I_baseline)<=12 AND at least 6/8 tasks have delta_V>=3 AND every task has delta_V>=-2 AND delta_V_easy>=0 AND delta_V_hard>=0
censor_rescue.three_stream_route: all 3 streams pass the same censor-reservoir route AND the intersection of their delta_V>=3 task sets has size at least 6

explicitly_forbidden.absolute_value_cap: The nuisance condition is a signed increase<=12, not abs(increase)<=12
explicitly_forbidden.post_hoc_mixed_reservoir_route: R_I=13 plus R_C=13 is deliberately rejected; no third route may be added after outcomes are seen

future_confirmation_gate_design.interpretation: These are complementary feasibility definitions for a future, newly frozen confirmation. They are not evaluated on model outputs here.
future_confirmation_gate_design.measurement_limit: R_I and R_C compare marginal reservoir counts. They do not show that the same item moved I->V or C->V and therefore do not prove item-level rescue.

semantic_rescue.per_stream: delta_V>=26 AND R_I>=26 AND signed(C_candidate-C_baseline)<=12 AND at least 6/8 tasks have delta_V>=3 AND every task has delta_V>=-2 AND delta_V_easy>=0 AND delta_V_hard>=0
semantic_rescue.three_stream_route: all 3 streams pass the same semantic-reservoir route AND the intersection of their delta_V>=3 task sets has size at least 6

thresholds.route_rule: (all3_semantic_reservoir_route) OR (all3_censor_reservoir_route); per-stream route mixing is forbidden
thresholds.task_rule: at_least_6 identical tasks must have delta_V>=3 in the intersection across all 3 streams
